values.note: 32 RV pads: 16 electric and 4 non-electric in the Beach Entrance loop on the east shore, and 12 non-electric pads off the Main Entrance on the southwest shore (8 by the playground, 4 by the boat ramp), plus four tent camping areas. The NRD's rules cap any camper unit at 102 inches wide and 40 ft long. Tents are not allowed on RV pads.

values.note: First come, first served; 'Reserving campsites is prohibited.' Pay within 30 minutes of arrival by scanning the QR code sign at the campsite (Set Your Sites, card only); Set Your Sites shows live availability on a map. Only RVs/campers on RV pads and they must be attended. Tents move every 7 days; extensions past 14 days need the manager's written permission.

note: Nemaha NRD recreation area on 160-acre Kirkman's Cove Lake, 2.5 mi W and 0.5 mi N of Humboldt. Two camping areas with separate entrances: the Beach Entrance loop off 715 Road on the east shore (all the electric pads, a few non-electric pads, tent camping and the sand swimming beach), and the non-electric pads off the Main Entrance from Hwy 4 on the southwest shore, by the playground and the boat ramp. A few pads on the west side of the Beach Entrance loop face the lake across open lawn. Boat ramp and dock, kayak launch (new 2026), 9-hole golf course adjacent. --Claude

WATERFRONT lakefront stands (lead, not a change): on NAIP leaf-on (180 m frame at 40.1879,-95.9901) the four pull-in pads on the west side of the Beach Entrance loop point toward the lake with the loop road behind them; their ends are ~45 m from the shore across open mown grass with scattered trees that don't screen it (the only things visible on it are a few fire rings/table spots). That is inside the ~50 m bound. The inner-loop pads have the loop road between them and the water (lakeview at best), and the swim beach sits at the loop's SE corner. The southwest pads (by the playground) sit behind a continuous treeline ~30-45 m from the water. Which pads are electric is not on any map I found.
